newsitem.title: UK: U-Freight's Boyer oversees Australian development.
newsitem.headline: U-Freight's Boyer oversees Australian development.

text.p: International transport and logistics group, U-Freight said that managing director of U-Freight America, Gene Boyer, has taken on corporate responsibility for the group's development in Australia.
Boyer, who is based in San Francisco, is now responsible for the group's corporate development in North America, Australia and Europe, the group said in a statement issued here.
"My role as corporate head has been conceived due to the marked similarities in these respective markets and how we deal with them," he added in the statement.

"What we are trying to achieve is a ... global forwarding company where customers can expect the same level of service anywhere in the world and yet is flexible enough to adapt and mould itself to the changing needs of the local markets," he said. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017 --
